The Streamlit Community Cloud API provides programmatic access to manage Streamlit applications hosted on Community Cloud. Developers can use this API to deploy apps from GitHub repositories, manage app secrets, view deployment logs, restart apps, and manage workspace settings. Authentication uses Streamlit-issued API tokens.
